This row makes Gate 1 reachable from outside the daemon module; landing a wire verb before the durable reader and its refusal matrix exist would expose a gate whose only satisfying path is the public core minter `grantHumanAuthority`, which accepts a caller-supplied principal and caller-supplied time.
